agents.purpose: Normalize approved inbound channel events and route them to deterministic queues.
Classify and prioritize imported communications while exposing uncertainty and escalation needs.
Summarize permitted Slack channel snapshots and identify mentions and unanswered questions.
Classify permitted email imports and draft routing recommendations without sending or deleting mail.
Monitor imported WhatsApp business conversations for unanswered, risky, or urgent items.
Combine communication risk signals into human-readable escalation packages with exact next decisions.
Research a consented or authorized lead using approved sources and distinguish facts from assumptions.
Map approved offers to documented customer needs and propose testable positioning.
Apply approved qualification criteria and explain evidence, uncertainty, and missing information.
Detect stale, inconsistent, or ownerless pipeline records and propose deterministic next actions.
Draft bounded proposals from approved scope, pricing, and evidence without making unauthorized commitments.
Prepare consent-aware follow-up sequences and timing recommendations for human approval.
Reconcile imported read-only revenue records and identify unmatched or duplicate entries.
Classify imported expenses under owner-approved categories and flag uncertain items.
Calculate deterministic period income, expenses, net, and trends from reconciled records.
Compare recorded usage and approved budgets, warn on thresholds, and block new model jobs when policy requires.
Track imported invoice states and surface overdue, duplicate, or mismatched items for owner review.
Prepare onboarding plans, required information lists, and accountable handoffs from approved contracts/scopes.
Convert approved scope and objectives into traceable milestones, tasks, dependencies, and review points.
Turn authorized meeting transcripts into factual summaries, decisions, actions, and unresolved questions.
Classify approved customer feedback, identify themes, and preserve verbatim evidence separately from interpretation.
Detect delivery, communication, satisfaction, and renewal risks using explicit rules and bounded interpretation.
Prepare evidence-based renewal briefs and options without committing price, terms, or outcomes.
Research audiences, competitors, demand signals, and opportunities with citations and capture dates.
Translate approved objectives and research into a channel-aware content strategy and test plan.
Draft truthful channel-specific copy from approved briefs, evidence, and brand rules.
Convert approved concepts into structured visual briefs without generating false claims or proprietary copies.
Review exact artifact revisions for evidence, brand, policy, privacy, duplication, and channel compliance.
Adapt an approved canonical concept into channel variants while preserving facts and approval lineage.
Classify imported community messages/comments, identify risk, and draft reply candidates for approval.
Interpret trusted campaign metrics against objectives and propose tests without claiming unsupported causality.
Evaluate system changes against architecture, security, operations, and simplicity constraints.
Design and implement tested internal automations in isolated development scope from approved specifications.
Run deterministic connector and import health checks and surface stale, failed, or mis-scoped integrations.
Audit approved knowledge stores for broken links, orphan notes, stale metadata, conflicts, and organization drift.
Review proposed changes and configurations for authorization, secret, data-isolation, approval, and supply-chain risks.
Execute approved verification commands and collect real build, test, migration, browser, and deployment evidence.
